paragraphs: Brett Anthony Foods is recalling WOW BAO CHEESEBURGER BAO BUNS with use-by date 10.01.27 and lot #26243 due to undeclared allergens [1]. The 10-ounce boxes were distributed in Alabama, Colorado, Connecticut, Georgia, Iowa, Maine, Massachusetts, and Michigan [1].

Multiple breakfast sandwich products face Listeria monocytogenes contamination recalls [4][6]. Grand Strand Sandwich Company is recalling Lunch Box Chicken Sausage Biscuit, Sausage Egg & Cheese Biscuit, Jumbo Sausage Biscuit, and Bacon Egg and Cheese Biscuit packages distributed between March 2 and November 10 [4]. Fresh & Ready Foods LLC expanded its recall to include Fresh to You Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwiches and Meals Made in Minutes Biscuit & Sausage Gravy from its Longview, Texas facility [6].

Additional recalls this week include ALDI's Priano Protein Carbonara and Herb & Cheese Tortelloni with code dates 10/5/2027 through 10/8/2026 due to potential pathogenic growth from improper temperature storage [7], Naia's Chocolate Banana Bar Sorbetto with code dates 10/5/2027 through 10/8/2026 for undeclared tree nuts, milk, and eggs [8], Shanghai San Niu's Evergreen and Salt and Pepper Soda Biscuits for undeclared milk and shrimp [3], and Larbi's Herb To Body Yellow Dock Root for possible Salmonella contamination [5].
